candidates.exact_span: wastestreams with a closed cup flashpoint of less than 140 degrees Fahrenheit or 60 degrees Centigrade using the test methods specified in 40 CPR 261.21
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a numeric flashpoint threshold and specifies the test method; different readings of the threshold, units, or applicable test method could change whether a reported flashpoint measurement is compared against an enforceable limit or left unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: discharges with pH lower than 5.0, unless the works are specifically designed to accommodate such discharges
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a numeric pH floor with a design-based exception; whether the exception applies changes the enforceable limit used for comparison, and unclear evidence on design accommodation leaves applicability or exceedance unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: heat in such quantities that the temperature at the POTW treatment plant exceeds 40 degrees Centigrade (104 degrees Fahrenheit) unless the Approval Authority, upon request of the POTW, approves alternate temperature limits
candidates.computation_change_reason: Provides a numeric temperature ceiling but allows alternate approved limits; interpretation of whether an approved alternate limit exists, and which temperature measurement location applies, changes the limit used for compliance comparison and whether the case stays unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: Any pollutant, including oxygen demanding pollutants (e.g., BOD), released in a discharge at a flow rate and/or pollutant concentration which will cause Interference with the POTW
candidates.computation_change_reason: Conditions enforceability on flow rate and/or concentration causing Interference rather than a fixed numeric limit; different interpretations of when Interference is triggered determine whether a numeric compliance comparison is applicable or the requirement is treated as non-numeric.

candidates.exact_span: Petroleum oil, non-biodegradable cutting oil, or products of mineral oil origin in amounts that will cause interference or pass through
candidates.computation_change_reason: Uses qualitative interference or pass-through criteria instead of a stated numeric limit; interpretation of those effects determines whether reported oil measurements are subject to numeric limit comparison or excluded from numeric compliance evaluation.

candidates.exact_span: Any trucked or hauled pollutants, except at discharge points designated by the POTW.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a conditional prohibition tied to POTW-designated discharge points; whether a discharge point is designated changes which limits and monitoring obligations apply, and missing designation evidence affects unresolved missing-data classification.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall require any indirect discharger to the treatment works to comply with the reporting requirements of Sections 204(b), 307, and 308 of the Act, including any requirements established under 40 CPR Part 403.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Imposes reporting obligations on indirect dischargers through the permittee; interpretation of which indirect dischargers exist and which Part 403 reporting requirements are incorporated changes whether monitoring/reporting was required for evaluated entities.

candidates.exact_span: Any new introduction of pollutants into the treatment works from an indirect discharger which would be subject to Sections 301 and 306 of the Act If it were directly discharging those pollutants
candidates.computation_change_reason: Triggers a notice obligation based on a counterfactual direct-discharge test under Sections 301 and 306; different readings of that conditional test change when notice—and related monitoring evidence expectations—apply, including whether absence of notice reflects no requirement or missing evidence.

candidates.exact_span: Any substantial change in the volume or character of pollutants being introduced into the treatment works by a source introducing pollutants into the treatment works at the time of issuance of the permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Conditions notice on what counts as a substantial change for sources existing at permit issuance; interpretation of substantiality and baseline character changes whether additional monitoring or reporting was required and how missing related evidence should be classified.
